verdict.rationale: Column is API-first, so every workflow runs headlessly over HTTP. Several documented features support CI automation: a fully sandboxed API where data persists like production, `/simulate/*` endpoints to drive test transfers, API keys scoped to sandbox or live mode, idempotency keys for safe retries, and a published OpenAPI spec (confirmed by probe) for generating clients. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guidance, an official CLI or first-party SDKs (an engineer says customers use raw HTTP), and independent hands-on reports of running Column in CI pipelines.
